methodology_and_units.estimating_methodology: Bottom-up work package estimating combining vendor fixed-price hardware quotes with parametric engineering labor rates.
methodology_and_units.level_of_precision: Rounded to nearest 1,000 SAR for capital assets and 100 SAR for consumables.

control_accounts.wbs_integration_approach: Control accounts mapped directly to Level 3 WBS work packages with monthly cost recording against specific ERP cost centers.

evm_and_thresholds.evm_measurement_technique: Weighted milestones for software delivery and percent complete with physical inspection for hardware installation.
evm_and_thresholds.escalation_procedure: Any cost variance exceeding 10% or cumulative CV exceeding 100,000 SAR triggers mandatory RCA and Steering Committee escalation.
